**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A clear and concise description of what is missing or inconvenient today, e.g. "I want to load the scenes in engine X but only .blend/.gltf are provided".

**Describe the solution you'd like**

What you would like to see — e.g. a new export format (USD, FBX binary, per-building splits), a new prop, a lower-polygon variant, or an improvement to the `tools/` scripts.

**Use case**

Which engine / simulator / research workflow would this enable?

**Additional context**

Add any other context or references (software versions, format specs, similar repos).
